contract.question: Will the Republican Party win the CA-06 House seat?
contract.resolves: Party of candidate winning the CA-06 U.S. House seat in the Nov. 3, 2026 midterm. Candidate party is ballot-listed or otherwise identifiable affiliation at time all 2026 House races are conclusively called. If candidate lacks ballot affiliation to Democratic/Republican, rule assigns based on party with which candidate most recently expressed intent to caucus at that call. Consensus credible reporting; if ambiguous, official U.S. government results specifically FEC.
